EX-99.1 2 alms-ex99d1.htm EX-99.1 ​ Exhibit 99.1 ​ ​ Alumis Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights Recent Business Updates ​ – New Phase 3 data demonstrated rapid and durable improvements in plaque psoriasis burden, adding to envudeucitinib’s differentiated clinical profile, including the highest publicly reported Week 48 PASI 100 response rate among existing and investigational oral psoriasis therapies – ​ – Alumis remains on track to submit an NDA for envudeucitinib in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in 4Q 2026 – ​ –Announced topline results from the LUMUS Phase 2b trial for envudeucitinib in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) – ​ SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., November 12, 2026 – Alumis Inc.

(Nasdaq: ALMS) , a late-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation targeted therapies for patients with immune-mediated diseases, today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and highlighted recent business updates and upcoming milestones. ​ “Each additional readout from the ONWARD program has strengthened the consistent body of evidence supporting envudeucitinib’s highly competitive profile in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis,” said Martin Babler, President and Chief Executive Officer of Alumis.
